job_description:
▶ About the Job
Hi! We’re the DLII Team (Department of Linguistic Intelligence and Interaction) — a passionate group of machine learning engineers and researchers exploring how language models can make technology more natural, capable, and useful.
Our mission is to bring cutting-edge LLM and agent technologies into real-world business applications. From empowering language models with agent-related abilities such as reasoning and tool calling, we’re constantly pushing the boundaries of what machines can understand and do.
If you’re excited about shaping the next generation of language-driven agents, you’ll fit right in.

▶ Our Focus Areas
We work on a range of projects at the intersection of SOTA research and real-world business problems. Some of our current focuses include:
▪️ LLM Enhancement
Improving small and medium-scale LLMs through technologies like Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT), reinforcement learning, and domain adaptation — enabling them to different domain and use-case needs.
▪️ Agent Systems & Applications
Designing LLM-based agents capable of multi-step reasoning and tool-calling, and building flexible agent frameworks that our business units can adapt to their unique workflows.
▪️ Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Building and refining pipelines that ground models with accurate, context-aware retrieval, including embedding, reranking, and knowledge integration.
▪️ Core NLP Research & Infrastructure
While our focus is on LLMs and agents, we still draw on our NLP foundation — from NER, summarization, and knowledge graph building, to document understanding — to strengthen our systems’ capabilities from multiple angles.

▶ What Your Day-to-Day Might Look Like
At DLII, every day brings a mix of research exploration and engineering craftsmanship. You might be optimizing model performance, experimenting with new training techniques, or transforming prototypes into production-ready systems that drive real business value.
Here’s a glimpse of what you might do:
▪️ Collaborate in small, agile team focusing on specific goals like RAG optimization or agent reasoning.
▪️ Package and deploy models as APIs or microservices for internal and external projects.
▪️ Participate in paper-reading sessions, demos, and retros to share findings and refine approaches.
▪️ Work closely with product teams to integrate intelligent agent systems into real-world workflows.

▶ Responsibilities
As part of the DLII team, you’ll:
▪️ Design, develop, and deploy LLM- and agent-powered solutions that bridge research and application.
▪️ Conduct applied research to explore novel architectures and training methods for LLMs.
▪️ Build and optimize pipelines for agent tasks.
▪️ Collaborate across teams to tailor solutions that align with business goals.
▪️ Deploy and optimize models across local and cloud-based environments.

▶ Why Join Us
At DLII, we believe innovation comes from curiosity and collaboration. You’ll get to:
⭐ Work on real-world LLM and agent challenges with measurable business impact.
⭐ Attend industry conferences and study the latest research together with teammates.
⭐ Share your ideas in an open, supportive environment that celebrates learning and experimentation.
We’re here to build intelligent systems that understand, reason, and help people — and we’d love for you to be part of that journey.
job_categories: Internet程式設計師, 軟體工程師, AI工程師

▪️ Have hands-on experience with deploying LLM using popular inference frameworks like vLLM, llama.cpp, or SGLang.

▪️ Communicate ideas clearly and enjoy collaborating across disciplines.

1.三年以上 Data QA、Data Engineering 或相關經驗。
2.精通 SQL（MySQL / Redshift），能撰寫複雜查詢與資料驗證邏輯。

4.具 Airflow 或其他資料流程編排工具實務經驗。
5.熟悉 Python，用於資料驗證與自動化測試腳本撰寫。
6.理解資料倉儲架構、ETL/ELT 流程與資料建模。
7.有大型資料集處理與效能調校經驗。
8.了解 Schema 演進、Data Contract 與 Metadata 管理概念。
9.熟悉遊戲測試流程、缺陷回報流程與版本控管（JIRA / Confluence）。

【軟技能與團隊特質】

 -  細心、有條理，具備優秀的問題分析與溝通能力。
 -  樂於與跨部門合作（Data Engineer、Data Scientist、PM），共同提升資料品質。
 -  具持續學習與探索新技術的動能。

job_description:
【職位概述】
集邦科技（TrendForce）為國際知名的市場研究機構，專注於高科技產業的深度分析與專業顧問服務，研究範疇涵蓋半導體、消費性電子、顯示面板、綠色能源及新興科技。我們誠摯邀請熟悉資料中心有線通訊產業、具備資料中心運作與有線網路技術專業知識的分析師加入團隊。此職位負責追蹤資料中心有線通訊設備（如交換機、光模組）出貨數據，並進行市場趨勢研究報告之撰寫，以及與客戶進行深度交流以掌握產業脈動。非常歡迎有資料中心有線通訊產業行銷、業務或產品相關經驗者，轉戰產業研究領域！

【Position Overview】
TrendForce is a globally recognized market research institution specializing in in-depth analysis and professional consulting services for the high-tech industry, focusing on fields such as semiconductors, consumer electronics, display panels, green energy, and emerging technologies. We are seeking a Senior Analyst familiar with the data center wired communication industry and knowledgeable in data center operations and wired network technologies. This role is responsible for tracking shipment data of server-related wired communication equipment (e.g., switches, optical modules) in data centers, authoring research reports, and communicating closely with clients to analyze market trends. Marketing, sales, or product professionals in this field who wish to transition to industry research are highly encouraged to apply!



【主要職責】
1. 建立資料庫，追蹤及分析資料中心所需有線通訊設備（如交換機、光模組等）的出貨量、產品類別與市場預測。
2. 追蹤資料中心網路設備與光模組供應商（例如Cisco、Arista、Juniper、NVIDIA/Mellanox、Broadcom等）及大型雲服務供應商（CSP，如AWS、Azure、GCP）之基礎設施策略與供應鏈動態。
3. 製作專業且具說服力的簡報，涵蓋資料中心有線通訊技術趨勢、設備出貨預測與供應鏈廠商發展變化，應用於內部討論或對客戶簡報。
4. 獨立與客戶交流、拜訪，收集市場最新動態與客戶需求，提供即時反饋及策略建議，並能將需求轉化為具商業價值的報告產品。
5. 與團隊合作，分享研究發現及資料中心有線通訊市場觀察，協力提升整體報告品質。

【Key Responsibilities】
1. Build and maintain a database to track and analyze shipment volumes, product segmentation, and market forecasts for wired communication devices (e.g., switches, optical modules) in data centers.
2. Monitor supply chain dynamics and strategies of major data center network equipment and optical module suppliers (such as Cisco, Arista, Juniper, NVIDIA/Mellanox, Broadcom, etc.), as well as major cloud service providers (CSPs like AWS, Azure, GCP), focusing on infrastructure investments and partnerships.
3. Create professional and persuasive presentations covering trends in data center wired communication technologies, shipment forecasts, and supply chain developments, for both internal and client-facing use.
4. Independently communicate and meet with clients, gather the latest market intelligence and customer needs, offer timely feedback and strategic advice, and convert client requirements into marketable research report products.
5. Collaborate closely with the analyst team to share findings and market insights on data center wired communication, jointly improving overall report quality.

TrendForce is a globally recognized market research institution specializing in in-depth analysis and professional consulting services for the high-tech industry, focusing on fields such as semiconductors, consumer electronics, display panels, green energy, and emerging technologies. We are seeking a Senior Analyst with expertise in automotive semiconductors, automotive electronics, and smart mobility to join our Semiconductor Research Division. 【Key Responsibilities】
1. Track and analyze global automotive semiconductor market trends—including MCUs, power components, sensors, automotive AI, etc.—as well as supply and demand, technology development, and competition
2. Collect, verify, and analyze automotive semiconductor market prices, supply chain, and application data to ensure intelligence accuracy
3. Utilize internal and external AI tools to accelerate data collection and consolidation, rapidly identifying key industry trends and risks

6. Collaborate with fellow analysts and internal teams to discuss findings and share industry insights

一、設計與開發 RAG（Retrieval-Augmented Generation）流程
建構高效且可擴充的 RAG 流程，支援 GenAI 應用場景，包括：
　- 資料預處理：將文本、圖像、程式碼等多種格式資料轉換為模型可理解的輸入
　- 向量嵌入：應用向量化技術（如 SentenceTransformers）將資料轉為向量表示，並儲存於向量資料庫
　- 相似度檢索：根據使用者查詢，快速檢索出語意上最相關的資料片段
　- 提示強化：整合檢索結果至 LLM 提示詞中，提升生成內容的準確性與相關性
　- 輸出生成：結合語境與知識基礎，由 GenAI 模型產出高品質內容
　- 評估並選用最適合的向量資料庫與嵌入模型（如 Pinecone、Milvus），確保系統效能與可擴充性
 　- 持續優化 RAG 整體流程的精準度、查詢速度與資源效率
 
二、建構與維運向量資料庫系統
根據業務需求選型向量資料庫，進行環境部署與性能調校
設計合理的資料 schema，並確保資料一致性、完整性與安全性

監控資料庫運作情況，持續進行效能優化與問題排查
 
三、開發與調優向量嵌入模型
根據不同資料類型與應用情境，選擇適用的嵌入技術與模型架構
使用現有工具（如 HuggingFace、SentenceTransformers）訓練或微調向量模型
建立模型效能評估機制，並依據結果進行優化與版本控管
 
四、提升 GenAI 應用品質
利用 RAG 技術降低幻覺（hallucination）風險，提升回應準確度與可信度
建立內容驗證與監控機制，確保模型輸出符合業務邏輯與事實基礎
持續推動 GenAI 應用可觀測性與品質保證流程
 
五、跨部門合作與技術溝通
與 GenAI 應用工程師、資料科學家及產品團隊緊密協作，確保資料應用與業務需求對齊
以簡明方式向非技術人員說明 RAG 技術與向量資料庫的運作邏輯與價值，推動跨部門共識與落地

掌握最新的 RAG 框架、向量資料庫技術與嵌入模型演進趨勢

積極參與相關研討會、工作坊與開發者社群，拓展技術視野與業界人脈

▪️ Build and optimize pipelines for agent tasks.
▪️ Collaborate across teams to tailor solutions that align with business goals.

At DLII, we believe innovation comes from curiosity and collaboration. You’ll get to:
⭐ Work on real-world LLM and agent challenges with measurable business impact.

負責生理訊號（ECG、呼吸阻抗、IMU 等）之演算法開發與產品化，包含訊號前處理（濾波、基線移除）、peak/事件偵測、特徵工程、統計分析、性能與壓力測試，並將 POC 演算法轉為可在行動端、gateway（Linux）與雲端部署的高品質程式碼。

二、主要職責：
1. 設計與實作生理訊號處理演算法（ECG、呼吸阻抗、IMU）：濾波、基線拉平、去噪、peak（如 R-peak）與事件偵測、呼吸率/HR/HRV 計算、姿態/動作偵測等。
2. 規劃整體演算法流程與系統架構，訂定輸入/輸出資料規格（data contracts）。
3. 撰寫結構化、可測試、可維護的程式碼（POC → 產品化改寫）。
4. 撰寫單元測試、整合測試、驗證腳本；制定測試規劃（accuracy、latency、robustness）。
5. 進行效能分析、記憶體與 CPU 優化（含多線程、SIMD、定點數實作等）、並規劃壓力測試場景。
6. 與 iOS/Android/嵌入式工程師共同將演算法移植或包裝（例如 C/C++ / Rust library 或 WASM），或作為雲端 microservice。
7. 撰寫技術文件、API 規格、驗收標準，並支援臨床/測試資料的分析、結果報告。
8. 協助產品經理/PM 定義性能指標 (KPIs)，並以數據驅動改進演算法。

三、必要技能：
1. 訊號處理 & 數學基礎：熟悉時域/頻域濾波器（IIR/FIR）、baseline wander removal、窗函數、resampling、spectral analysis、特徵提取、統計檢定。
2. ECG / Resp / IMU 經驗：至少有一種生理訊號（心電圖、呼吸阻抗、或慣性量測單元）之實務演算法開發經驗；能正確實作 R-peak / QRS / P/T 檢測或呼吸率偵測、IMU 活動分類等。
3. 程式語言：精通 Python（NumPy, SciPy, pandas）、熟悉 C/C++（或 Rust）以做效能關鍵程式；若需行動端移植則熟悉 Swift/Objective-C 或 Kotlin/Java 為佳。
4. 機器學習 / 統計：會用機器學習方法（常見分類器、序列模型、時間序列特徵工程）與評估指標（sensitivity, specificity, F1, AUC, RMSE 等）。
5. 軟體工程良好實踐：單元測試、CI/CD、版本控制（git）、code review、文件化。
6. 效能分析工具：能用 profilers (e.g., perf, valgrind, Instruments, gprof) 做 CPU/Memory 分析與優化。
7. 系統整合：了解跨平台部署（iOS/Android/native libraries、Linux gateway、Docker、雲端）與網路/通訊限制（latency、bandwidth）。
8. 溝通：能與產品、QA、嵌入式、App 團隊協作並清楚呈現結果與 trade-offs。

• Familiarity with programming skills in C++ or R is a plus.

tags: 年終獎金, 節日獎金/禮品, 津貼/補助, 優於勞基法特休, 彈性上下班
job_description:
【職務簡述】

1. 根據遊戲玩法與規則，應用機率論、期望值計算、馬可夫鏈 (Markov Chains) 等統計方法，設計遊戲數值結構。
2. 深度結合遊戲體感需求，設計獎勵頻率、爆發區間與波動度 (Volatility/Variance) 曲線，以創造最佳的玩家刺激度與娛樂性。
3. 建立數學模型後，撰寫完整且清晰的數學設計文件。
4. 撰寫機率模組演算程式（模擬工具，Simulator）進行數值運算。
5. 執行大樣本模擬，驗證數學模型的正確性與數值一致性。
6. 與伺服器端協作，確保機率模型在實作層面的一致性。
7. 針對產品營運數據與競品數據，進行專業統計、趨勢觀察與分析。
8. 評估數值調整對玩家體感的影響，根據數據與市場趨勢，調整遊戲參數與玩法，以最佳化遊戲體驗。

【需求條件】

1. 數學與統計專業能力：
- 具備紮實的機率論、期望值計算基礎。
- 具備數值資料的統計、分析與機率設計能力。

2. 遊戲體感設計思維：
- 具備將抽象的「娛樂性」與「刺激感」轉化為具體數值參數的能力。
- 熟悉利機率控制來達成不同的玩家體感目標。
- 對遊戲的獎勵回饋節奏與玩家心理有深刻理解。

3. 程式與工具技能：
- 能獨立撰寫模擬工具。

4. 分析與溝通能力：
- 具備對產品及競品數據進行專業統計分析的能力。
- 具備良好的邏輯思考能力，工作態度主動、積極、負責。

Job Title: AI Compiler Engineer

Job Description:
Overview:
We are seeking a skilled and motivated AI Compiler Engineer to lead the development of our AI compiler for the Neural Processing Unit (NPU). As part of our team, you will play a critical role in transforming high-level neural network workloads (such as CNNs and transformer models) into efficient machine code that maximizes inference performance, minimizes power consumption, and optimizes memory usage.

Responsibilities:
1. Compiler Development:
• Design and develop an AI compiler that translates high-level neural network descriptions (in frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, or ONNX) into optimized machine code for the NPU.
• Implement parsing algorithms to analyze neural network graphs and extract relevant information for compilation.
2. Optimization Strategies:
• Optimize the computational graph by applying techniques such as operator fusion, kernel selection, and memory layout transformations.
• Minimize inference time, reduce power consumption, and optimize memory footprint through intelligent code generation.
3. Performance Profiling and Analysis:
• Profile compiled code to identify bottlenecks and areas for improvement.
• Collaborate with hardware architects to understand NPU microarchitecture and tailor optimizations accordingly.
4. Code Generation and Lowering:
• Generate efficient machine code from the intermediate representation of neural network operations.
• Ensure compatibility with the NPU's instruction set architecture.
5. Integration and Testing:
• Integrate the AI compiler into the overall software stack, including runtime libraries and drivers.
• Develop test suites to validate correctness, performance, and compatibility across various neural network models.
6. Documentation and Communication:
• Document design decisions, algorithms, and implementation details.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including hardware engineers, software developers, and researchers.

Qualifications:
• Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
• Minimum of 3 years of experience in compiler development, preferably with exposure to AI or machine learning.
• Proficiency in C/C++/Python programming and familiarity with compiler construction.
• Knowledge of neural network frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.) and their intermediate representations.
• Experience with performance profiling tools and optimization techniques.
• Understanding of machine learning concepts and hardware architectures.
• Familiarity with data structures, optimization algorithms, and DevOps tools (such as Git, CI/CD pipelines).
• Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
• Excellent communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Skills:
• Familiarity with deep learning frameworks and libraries.
• Knowledge of hardware acceleration technologies and frameworks.
• Experience of tensor computation and optimization.
• Previous work in compiler for CPU, GPU, DSP, NPU is a plus.

If you are passionate about compiler engineering, AI optimization, and want to be part of a team driving innovation, we encourage you to apply. Join us in shaping the future of AI acceleration.

We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer to design, build, and scale next-generation AI-assisted products, including:
● Q&A system based on advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems
● Agentic programming workflows based on technical specifications
● Knowledge management automation, document intelligence, and semantic search

You will collaborate closely across various engineering teams to bring AI products from prototype → production → continuous improvement → scaling.

[Responsibilities]

● Design and implement scalable AI architectures, including LLM pipelines, RAG systems, agentic workflows, and orchestration layers.
● Develop production-grade AI features for Q&A, summarization, extraction, automation, and knowledge workflows.
● Build reusable components such as tool integrations, vector retrieval stages, evaluation pipelines, and model-serving modules.
● Establish best practices for model versioning, experiment tracking, data governance, and quality assurance.
● Diagnose system bottlenecks and ensure reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency of AI systems.
● Support the end-to-end lifecycle of agent-based AI products from development, launch, monitoring, to iterative enhancement.

[Minimum Qualifications]

● Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent practical experience).
● 5+ years of software development experience in at least one programming language (Python preferred).
● 3+ years of experience in one or more ML-specialized domains, such as:
     ○ speech/audio processing
     ○ reinforcement learning
     ○ ML infrastructure / MLOps
     ○ or other large-scale machine learning domains
● Strong system design and system architecture abilities for building scalable AI services.
● Understanding of system administration fundamentals and experience troubleshooting production systems.
● Solid knowledge of MLOps concepts, including: model lifecycle, inference optimization, monitoring and CI/CD for ML workflows
● Hands-on experience delivering LLM-based applications such as RAG systems, agent workflows, structured reasoning, or document intelligence.
● Proficiency with Python and modern AI/ML frameworks (PyTorch, Transformers, LangChain/LangGraph).
● Experience with cloud platforms, Docker, Kubernetes, or similar infrastructure.
● Ability to work cross-functionally with various engineering teams.

    ○ fallback/recovery strategies
    ○ evaluation and continuous improvement

總部位於矽谷，Quid是一家快速成長且充滿創業精神的公司。在全球社群媒體分析平台上，我們處於世界領先地位！

About Quid
Quid is a pioneer in leveraging cutting-edge technology to address real-world challenges. We don’t just deliver software — we deliver outcomes. Our mission is to transform data into insight, enabling our clients to make better strategic decisions.

About This Team
This team plays a central role in that mission. We empower our Outcome Engineers to deliver customized insights efficiently and support other engineering teams by providing open-source LLM platforms, conducting model benchmarking, and driving AI innovations to handle large social media datasets across the company.
We are seeking entrepreneurial and technically strong Machine Learning Engineers who are passionate about applying Large Language Models (LLMs), NLP, and data engineering to build intelligent systems and infrastructure that enable scalable, outcome-driven work.


Your Role
As a Machine Learning Engineer at Quid, you will build the AI and data analysis pipelines that power our insight-generation process. Your work will combine LLM integration, NLP expertise, and applied machine learning to empower internal teams to extract, organize, and synthesize insights from complex datasets at scale.
You’ll work with both open-source and proprietary LLMs to create tools and workflows that enable our Outcome Engineers to produce consistent, high-quality analytical outputs efficiently.


You will:
- Design and implement AI pipelines that automate or accelerate insight creation and tuning.
- Design and refine prompt strategies and model selection to optimize performance, precision, and cost.
- Apply machine learning and statistical techniques to structure, enrich, and interpret large datasets, especially text data.
- Build and maintain scalable model-serving systems — such as hosting open-source LLMs and word embeddings — to support AI-driven analytics across engineering and analysis teams.
- Maintain rigorous testing, benchmarking, and evaluation of both open-source and proprietary LLM models.

You may be a good fit if you:
- Hold a bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field (advanced degrees are a plus).
- Are fluent in Python and familiar with modern AI/ML frameworks.
- Possess real-world experience in NLP and data processing — for example, semantic search, entity extraction, summarization, and more.
- Have solid knowledge of prompt tuning.
- Are familiar with processing and analyzing large datasets.
- Demonstrate exceptional problem-solving abilities and the capacity to work autonomously or as part of a team.
- Communicate clearly and thrive in an agile, outcome-focused environment.
- Have strong written and verbal English skills.

Preferred Qualifications
- Familiarity with embedding-based search and vector databases.
- Experience with model evaluation and prompt optimization tools.
- Experience with data pipelines and workflow orchestration tools such as Argo Workflows, Airflow, or Kubeflow.
- 3+ years of experience in software and machine learning development.
- Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.

與營運、行銷與食安團隊合作，開發自動化工具與 n8n 流程。
持續研究 AI 在電商應用的新玩法。

◆ 多模型實驗環境：可同時使用 GPT、Claude、Gemini。

* Proficiency in C/C++ and Python; familiarity with embedded Linux or RTOS environments
* Hands-on experience with camera interfaces (MIPI CSI, USB UVC, Ethernet IPCam)

* Familiar with communication protocols (UART, I²C, SPI, RS-485, CAN, Ethernet)
* Experience with build systems (Yocto, CMake, Buildroot) and kernel driver integration
* Ability to read and interpret schematics and low-level hardware documentation

---
Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with thermal imaging sensors (e.g., FLIR, Lynred) or machine vision applications
* Familiarity with AI model deployment on edge (TensorRT, ONNX, OpenVINO, etc.)
* Knowledge of video encoding/decoding (H.264/H.265), RTSP/Web streaming pipeline optimization
* Experience with EMI/EMC considerations and rugged system design
* Exposure to ISO/MIL-STD testing and defense/maritime compliance environments

---

Work Conditions

* Hands-on lab work with development boards, test fixtures, and diagnostic tools
* Occasional travel for integration support, client testing, or on-site deployment
* Multi-project coordination with hardware, software, and system integration teams
* Fast-paced R\&D environment with real-world performance and reliability targets

- 執行 RHEL 作業系統與應用軟體的安裝、升級與最佳化。
6.硬體專業疑難排解
- 在 Linux 叢集環境中診斷並解決伺服器、網路設備與周邊硬體故障，應用邏輯分析與診斷工具。

Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more efficiently. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly sophisticated world of chip, board, and system develop. 

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior DRC QA Engineer to join our Calibre DRC QA team. -Execute complex test suites, including regression, functional, performance, stress, and integration testing on diverse IC layout data (e.g., GDSII, OASIS) across various technology nodes.
-Lead the development and execution of comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test methodologies for new features and enhancements.
-Analyze product specifications, design documents, and customer requirements to ensure thorough test coverage for IC physical verification.
-Collaborate with R&D, Product Engineers, and Application Engineers to understand complex reliability challenges and translate them into effective test scenarios.

This job requires the candidate to make immediate contributions to the team. The candidate should have strong testing abilities and have knowledge of the IC industry. The ideal candidate should also exhibit the following behavioral traits:
-  An innate desire to learn new things and quickly assimilate knowledge
-  Problem-solving skills
-  Strong great teammate with solid interpersonal skills
-  The ability to work on assignments independently or with small teams
-  Eagerness to break software and a curiosity of how things work
-  A detailed oriented mind

-  Master degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or related subject area
-  5+ years in SW Quality Assurance with solid scripting programming skills
-  Extensive Linux or Unix operating system experience
-  Validated experience writing Tcl code
-  Shell Scripting experience (e.g., bash, ksh, csh)

FAMILIAR WITH USING DEFECT TRACKING SYSTEMS
-  Excellent Written and Verbal Communication Skills
-  Knowledge of IC design flows

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
-  Extensive hands-on experience with Calibre nmDRC for design rule checking
-  Strong proficiency in writing, debugging, and optimizing Calibre SVRF (Standard Verification Rule Format) rule decks for DRC.
-  In-depth understanding of foundry rule decks, Process Design Kits (PDKs), and their structures
-  Familiarity with layout editors
-  Strong understanding of software QA methodologies

- 100Gbps/40Gbps/25Gbps/10Gbps serdes, USB3.1/3.2, PCI-E Gen2/3/4, SATA3, high-speed interface design and measurement experience

- Outdoor, industrial-grade product design experience.
- Experience in 400G switch products.

2. 招募分析與人力規劃支援
• 確認各倉庫的實際人力現況與缺口，協助追蹤 active headcount 與 gap。

Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more efficiently. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly sophisticated world of chip, board, and system design. 

Real trendsetters in every language.

Before our software developers write even a single line of code, they have to understand what drives our customers. What is the environment and the user story based on? Implementation means trying, testing, and improving outcomes until a final solution emerges. Knowledge means exchange discussions with colleagues from all over the world. Join our team and enjoy the freedom to think in completely new categories.

Be an integral part of a team that is developing comprehensive verification IPs for interfaces such as PCIe Gen5/Gen6, USB3.2, 400Gigabit Ethernet, DDR5, LPDDR5 and leading coherency protocols like CXL.

We make real what matters.

This is your role.

-  Verification IP’s help design teams find more bugs in less time than conventional simulation techniques.

-  You will specify, implement, test and improve these verification components for a wide range of end user applications.

-  You will work on technologies involving SV, UVM, Assertions, Coverage, Test plan, BFM design, debug, and logger.

-  You will harmonize with TMEs and Field AEs or directly with customers to deploy or resolve customer issues.

We don’t need superheroes, just super minds.

-  Use Verilog / SystemVerilog to develop IC Verification IP

-  Establish an IP test and verification environment for communication protocols such as CXL/PCI-Express Gen 6/USB 4.0 /DDR/Ethernet

-  All IPs are software modules that simulate the behavior of circuits in high-level languages, and do not need FPGAs.

-  Compared with IC design which focuses on circuit functions, this position focuses more on the development of the entire system.

-  In addition to the development and verification environment, it is also responsible for customer support and training.

-  Read the latest specifications and support customers

-  Work on technologies involving SV, UVM, assertions, coverage, test plan, BFM design, debug, and logger

-  English reading and writing skills are required.

-  Most customers are located in the US and the engineers may need to have meetings with R&Ds in other countries depending on the situation. English listening and speaking skills are required.

Candidates who are enthusiastic in writing programs, are interested in facing customers, and have knowledge or interest in IC design to join us.

We’ve got quite a lot to offer. How about you

This role is based in Taipei but you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries – and the shape of things to come.

The pace of innovation in electronics is constantly accelerating. To enable our customers to deliver life-changing innovations to the world faster and to become market leaders, we are committed to delivering the world’s most comprehensive portfolio of electronic design automation (EDA) software, hardware, and services. We, at Siemens EDA enable companies to develop better electronic products faster and more efficiently. Our innovative products and solutions help engineers conquer design challenges in the increasingly sophisticated worlds of board and chip design

▪️Is comfortable coding in Python, and familiar with SQL, Git, and Web API tools like Flask or FastAPI.
▪️Has experience working on machine learning projects — from experimentation to deployment.
▪️Enjoys working in a team and communicates ideas clearly and effectively.
If you’re curious, hands-on, and always up for a new challenge — that’s a big plus!

▶About the Job◀
Hi! We’re the DCS Team(Department of Cognition and Sensing)— a vibrant group of machine learning engineers, data scientists, and software architects who love exploring new ideas and building meaningful solutions with AI.
We work on cutting-edge machine learning applications, especially in the areas of Computer Vision(CV)and Multi-modal AI. Whether it’s extracting key data from documents, generating image captions, or building smart visual search systems — we’re passionate about bringing intelligence into daily workflows and helping people save time and energy.
Our team culture is open, experimental, and supportive. We’re not afraid to try new things, break stuff, and celebrate wins — big or small. You'll get the chance to work on real-world problems, collaborate across teams, and see your ideas come to life in products used by real customers.

▶Our Focus Areas◀
We work on:
▪️Visual Document Understanding(VDU)
Extracting meaningful data from complex documents like receipts, invoices, and contracts.
▪️Key Information Extraction(KIE)
Pulling out key details like names, dates, and prices from scanned or digital documents.
▪️Image Captioning
Teaching machines to describe what they see — helpful for accessibility, search, and context.
▪️Visual Search(Multi-RAG)
Enabling smart search experiences by combining image and text queries.
▪️Visual Question Answering(VQA)
Answering questions about visual content, combining CV and natural language understanding.
▪️Multi-modal Applications
Building systems that integrate multiple inputs — like image + text — to solve complex tasks.
We collaborate closely with other business teams to explore real-world use cases, deliver solutions, and iterate quickly. You’ll also have the opportunity to attend tech conferences, study SOTA papers, and share what you learn with our internal community.

▶What Your Day-to-Day Might Look Like◀
Life at DCS is a mix of research and engineering
Some days, you’ll feel like a researcher: reading papers, designing experiments, preparing datasets, or testing new model architectures. Other days, you’ll be deep into engineering work — building internal frameworks, packaging models into APIs, and deploying models at scale.
Here’s a brief overview of our daily rhythm:
▪️Small, mission-based squads working on different goals(VDU, visual search, etc.), with lots of cross-team collaboration.
▪️Warm-up meetings to sync up on goals, share progress, and ask for support.
▪️Journal clubs to discuss the latest research, tools, or techniques.
▪️Demos and retros to present your work and reflect on what’s working.
⭐We love building, sharing, and growing together — both technically and personally.

▶Responsibilities◀
As part of the DCS team, you’ll:
▪️Design and build ML-powered solutions — from model training to wrapping them into APIs.
▪️Stay updated on the latest SOTA research and apply novel ideas in real-world scenarios.
▪️Collaborate with other business teams to design ML-driven features that meet customer needs.
▪️Optimize and deploy models to run efficiently across various environments — including on-prem devices and cloud infrastructure.

Ready to join us and build smarter things together?
We’d love to hear from you — whether you’re passionate about machine learning, excited about vision or multi-modal challenges, or simply curious about what we’re building at DCS. Let’s talk :)

負責分析AI算法在實際系統架構運行時的效能瓶頸。
AI 應用成為近幾年的主流，軟體服務的效能依賴於幾個重點：系統架構設計、演算法的實作、硬體規格。
過去為了提升協作開發效率，計算機領域主要朝著抽象化的方式，降低各層互相的耦合性。
然而，這其中的權衡奠基在過去硬體隨著摩爾定律效能快速的成長，在大型系統中往往能藉由過剩的硬體效能彌補抽象化造成的損失。 然而，AI 時代迎來模型參數和運算需求指數成長的情況，這是少數已經具有商業價值需求的算法，超出現有硬體算力需求的狀況。 所以，以整體作為優化的研究，成為當前相當具有價值的工作。縱向的打破各層之間的抽象，找出不同實作之間能獲得最佳效能的搭配。
1. 基於演算法(多為平行運算)估算運算複雜度和空間使用量
2. 基於硬體配置，估算演算法在系統上的理論表現
3. 設計 DOE 實驗，驗證實際數據與理論數據的誤差
4. 基於實驗結果，找出演算法、軟體實作、系統、硬體的瓶頸
5. 實作優化算法，藉由實驗結果和理論分析證明其有效性
6. 撰寫技術文件，提供應用服務端作為實作參考。

我們擁有先進的數據管理和分析系統，將數據驅動作為日常決策的核心。我們深知在現今數位化時代，數據是企業成功的關鍵。為了達成這項目標，我們會深度參與公司所推動的各種項目，和業務團隊、分析團隊進行緊密、細緻的資訊分享與知識傳遞，並為專案提供堅實的資料保障。

作為資料基礎設施團隊的一員，我們熟練運用諸如 AWS、GCP、Azure、ElasticSearch 等主流雲端平台，以及 Hadoop、Spark、Kafka 等開源技術，建構靈活、高效的資料基礎架構。
我們會負責處理各種類型的資料。我們的工作從最原始的日誌資料和應用程式埋點資料出發，針對不同的資料使用場景、資料時效性和冷熱資料類別，經過精心的清洗和加工，將其轉化為可以直接驅動業務的數據形態。

我們的工作直接影響公司的資料治理和決策能力。透過優化數據流程和提升數據質量，我們為公司提供了可靠的數據基礎，為公司的發展提供有力支持。

iGuard 機器視覺檢測設備 (B2B) 與世界印刷設備龍頭 Heidelberg 海德堡印刷、電子材料業龍頭 Nan Ya Plastics 南亞塑膠、台光電子、生益電子等許多世界級的企業合作，提供自動光學檢測/機器視覺的服務，進行高端新產品開發及各檢測設備機型的銷售。行業跨足印刷檢測、電子業、紡織業、玻璃業，包含膠印機在線檢測、印刷光膜材料檢測、銅箔基板檢測、含浸檢測、電子布(玻纖布)、紡織布料檢測、汽車玻璃檢測等各製程檢測。iGuard 的檢測系統獲得經濟部工業局技術服務機構服務能量登錄證書，目前我們的檢測系統與設備已遍布全世界，包含德國、日本、美國、中國大陸等各地的製造業。

[關於職務]
這位電腦視覺演算法工程師主要會負責 iGuard 機器視覺檢測平臺的演算法開發，你會需要捲起袖子把手弄髒動手做。你會碰到演算法底層，並且將演算法實作出來，整合到 AOI 檢測軟體，用 CUDA 加速電腦視覺演算法，偵測影像的角落/邊緣/直線/對齊，以快速的反應能力和 FAE 同事協作客戶現場驗證。我們正在尋找技術與經驗兼備的人才，和我們一起開發新功能的同時，也能維護基礎架構彈性 (Scalability) 與穩定性 (Availability)，持續提升 iGuard 在全球市場上的競爭力。

[工作內容] 
1. 開發及維護 iGuard 用於工業檢測產品中的相關演算法。 
2. 以 C/C++ 實作開發影像處理程式，維護既有演算法（C/C++）。
3. 開發及優化辨識演算法，進行影像分析。
4. 影像處理之技術研究、開發、軟體設計、效能評估及優化。

[條件要求] 
1. 具影像處理技能，了解演算法背後的數學細節，並且可從頭實作。
2. 熟悉電腦視覺函式庫（如 OpenCV、EmguCV、HikiVision 等）的功能細節，並且處理過原始資料raw data。 
3. 用過 CUDA 實作影像相關演算法，熟悉加速、平行化、效能最佳化；對程式結構和效率優化相關的背景知識紥實。
4. 有影像處理基礎(影像處理演算法/電腦視覺演算法/一般演算法)，熟悉數值計算、DSP 訊號處理和資料結構。
5. 特質/能力：對技術有熱誠，不滿足於用現成函式庫兜成果，喜歡研究演算法底層細節，對於技術保有「打破沙鍋研究到底」的精神。

[加分條件]
1. 對即時影像處理或 CUDA 有經驗。
2. 具電腦視覺、智慧型影像分析等相關開發經驗。
3. 有 AOI 產業經驗或是影像處理經驗。
4. 有 OpenCV 使用經驗。

91APP 成立於 2013 年，為國內首家專精於虛實融合 OMO（Online-Merge-Offline）的新零售雲端服務商，目前擁有穩定且持續成長的客戶群。

✔  品牌客戶數據洞察：將數據轉化為行動方案，透過會員、商品、通路等分析，協助品牌找出關鍵問題及成長機會點。
✔  數據產品研發 / AI 工具應用：參與名單模型、商品數據洞察等產品研發，並運用 AI 工具提升分析效率與應用深度。

在 91APP 擔任數據分析顧問，最大的不同是能接觸到多元產業與大規模資料。
目前服務品牌涵蓋女裝、鞋包、美妝、保養、流行服飾、outdoor 等等。
你將操作上千家商店的資料，包含交易、瀏覽行為、APP 使用與線上線下交互數據，24x7 持續運作。能挖掘出多少價值，取決於你的洞察與創意。

✨ 我們希望你在履歷與面試中呈現
你處理資料的能力，以及根據分析結果進行決策或解決問題的經驗。

- 深入分析我們的目標客戶（SME 業主、經理人）的使用場景與潛在痛點。
- 解讀 AI 互動數據，設計、撰寫、測試並迭代優化「高情商」與「高專業度」的 Prompts，引導 AI 產出兼具策略深度與實用性的建議。

2. RAG (或其他類似技術) 解決方案實作：
- 主導或參與 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) 系統的架構設計與實作。
- 運用 LangChain、LlamaIndex 等框架，串接並管理我們的專業知識庫（如管理學、人資法規、產業報告等）。

3. AI 解決方案框架設計 (Solution Framing)：
- 面對客戶的營運痛點（例如：「我們的人才流動率很高」、「我想做數位轉型但不知從何開始」），你將與產品經理協同作戰。

4. 效能監控與迭代 (Performance & Iteration)：
- 建立並追蹤 AI 回應的品質指標（如準確性、相關性、流暢度）。
- 分析使用者反饋與互動日誌，找出模型或 RAG 流程的瓶頸，並提出具體的優化策略。


【必要條件】
1. 卓越的語言駕馭力（Prompt 大師）：
- 擁有豐富的 Prompt Engineering 實戰經驗，對中（繁）文的語意、語氣和情境有高度敏感性。

（面試要求）請務必準備 2-3 個你最自豪的 Prompt Engineering 作品集，展示你如何透過指令設計，將 AI 的回答從「堪用」提升至「卓越」。

2. 紮實的工程技術力（RAG 專家）：
- 精通 Python，並熟悉至少一種主流 LLM 的 API（如 OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini）。
- 具備 RAG 的實際導入與調優經驗，熟悉 LangChain 及/或 LlamaIndex。

（面試要求） 你需要能清晰描述你過去如何實作 RAG 流程，包含你選擇了哪些工具（如 Pinecone, Elasticsearch 等）以及為什麼。

3. 敏銳的商業產品思維（解決方案架構師）：
- 具備強大的商業理解力與邏輯拆解能力，能快速抓到客戶的「痛點背後的痛點」。
- 不只等待需求，而是能主動思考「AI 還能為客戶做什麼？」。

（面試要求） 我們會提供一個真實的客戶痛點情境，請你現場設計一個解決方案框架。

【你將獲得的】
1. 一個高影響力的舞台： 你的工作成果將直接定義我們的核心產品，並賦能數以萬計的台灣中小企業。

4. 具競爭力的薪酬與福利： 我們願意為頂尖的「樞紐人才」提供相應的回報。

job_description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative AI Security Scientist to join our RDSec team, which is a global team responsible for governance, risk assessment and compliance of Trend Micro software products and services. This unique role bridges the gap between theoretical AI security research and practical enterprise security implementation. The successful candidate will be responsible for defining acceptable security posture for new AI applications and services, and lead the effort of designing and implementing related mitigations and remediations to prevent potential risks caused by adoption of AI services.

You will act as the organization’s expert on AI risks, working to proactively identify, assess, and mitigate emerging threats across the entire AI pipelines and translating complex security requirements into scalable, deployable security services.

[Key Responsibilities]

AI Security Risk Assessment
1. AI Threat Modeling & Risk Assessment: Lead the analysis and assessment of security and privacy risks inherent in large language models (LLMs), Generative AI services, and other machine learning applications (e.g., prompt injection, data poisoning, model extraction, and privacy breaches).
2.Policy and Compliance: Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to ensure AI applications adhere to internal policies and external regulations (e.g., NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, emerging AI-specific laws).
3.Vulnerability Analysis: Study and document potential vulnerabilities within AI ecosystems and pipelines, including model integrity, training data exposure/leakage, and inference endpoints.
4.Remediation Design: Design and recommend effective security controls and mitigations to address identified risks, translating security requirements into actionable engineering plans.

AI Security Implementation and Engineering Leadership
1.Security Service Implementation: Lead the technical implementation of specific AI-related security services, such as input/output content filters, adversarial defense mechanisms, and secure model serving architectures.
2.Coding Assistant Security: Specialize in securing coding assistant tools, analyzing the risks of code generation and suggestion, and designing guardrails to prevent the introduction of insecure code or intellectual property leakage.
3.MLSecOps Integration: Partner with ML/AI Engineers and Data Scientists to embed security practices into the MLOps pipeline, championing a "security-by-design" approach for all AI initiatives.
4.Research & Advisory: Stay current with the rapidly evolving field of AI security and attack vectors. Provide expert consultation to product and engineering teams on best practices for secure AI development.
job_categories: 軟體工程師, AI工程師, 資安工程師
other_conditions:
[Required Qualifications]

1.Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, or a related technical field.
2.Experience: 5+ years of experience in Software Security, with at least 2 years focused specifically on AI/ML security, MLOps security, or cloud-native security.
3.Deep AI/ML Understanding: Strong foundational knowledge of Machine Learning algorithms, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Generative AI architectures. Must be able to reason about a model’s vulnerabilities at a conceptual level.
4.Technical Proficiency:
- Proficiency in Python and experience with ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
- Familiarity with Cloud Security principles (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
- Experience with CI/CD/MLOps pipelines and implementing security automation within them.
- User experience of AI coding assistant framework such as Github Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, Dify/n8n, and so on.
5.GRC Expertise: Solid understanding of Governance, Risk, and Compliance principles, risk assessment methodologies, and industry security frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001, ISO 42001)

[Preferred Qualifications]
1.Experience in a role directly involving the security of coding assistant or developer tools.
2.Advanced degree (Ph.D. or Master’s) in a relevant field.
3.Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CRISC, or specialized certifications like Certified AI Security Professional (CAISP).
4.Experience publishing research or presenting on topics related to AI Security or Adversarial Machine Learning.
5.Familiarity with software supply chain security as it applies to dependencies in ML models and training data.

job_description:
【關於安盛】
安盛資訊代理Product Lifecycle Management(PLM)與Application Lifecycle Management(ALM)解決方案，主要應用於中大型製造業產品開發(研發)，我們的客戶大多是上市/上櫃公司。安盛目前已經實現 PLM + AI 應用案例，打造企業級 AI 平台解決方案，專注於文件知識檢索（RAG）、權限管理（MCP）與企業內部 LLM 應用的整合。詳細內容請至公司官網 https://anselm.com.tw/

我們正在尋找對尖端 AI 技術充滿熱情且具備學習熱忱的實習生加入我們的團隊。這不是一般的AI應用開發職位，而是要求深度理解企業產品開發流程與軟體開發週期的專業角色。

加入我們的團隊，您將有機會：

■ 深入學習與實作
系統性地學習業界領先的 PLM 與 ALM 解決方案，掌握其核心概念、流程與應用，有機會參與實際專案，了解如何運用這些系統提升研發效率、優化產品品質並加速上市時程。
■ 探索 AI 的無限可能
在熟悉 PLM 與 ALM 的基礎上，探索如何將最新的 AI 技術融入企業研發流程，開發專屬的 AI 應用。
■ 參與創新專案
與客戶合作，共同發想、設計並實作研發創新的 AI 解決方案，例如：
利用 AI 分析產品需求與設計規格，提升設計效率與準確性。
運用 AI 預測產品開發風險，協助團隊提前應對。
結合 AI 分析測試數據，自動化缺陷檢測與報告生成。
透過 AI 驅動的知識管理，提升研發團隊的協同效率。
■ 培養專業領域經驗
了解企業研發部門的運作模式與痛點，培養將技術應用於實際業務場景的能力。
■ 獲得職涯發展優勢
透過紮實的 PLM/ALM 知識與創新的 AI 應用實戰經驗，為您未來的職涯發展奠定堅實的基礎。

【發展機會】
■ 專業培訓
由中高階主管帶領，並透過跨部門的學習，培養之後成為正職專案顧問所需要的策略思維及專業技能。
■ 升遷管道
表現符合預期者將有機會晉升為正職專案顧問，同步調整薪資，並適用顧問獎金辦法。
■ 進修學習
公司提供不定期聘請業師或提供外部訓練。

【工作內容】
本職位負責企業級 AI 系統（RAG 知識檢索與 MCP 服務平台）的設計與開發，整合 LLM 模型、資料庫與後端服務，打造智慧化文件與權限管理解決方案。
主要工作內容如下：

▶規劃與開發 RAG（Retrieval-Augmented Generation）應用架構，串接大型語言模型（LLM）與向量資料庫。
▶ 協助測試各組合的 Embedding 模型+向量資料庫+Inference 模型，建構適合的 RAG 框架
▶建置 MCP（Model Control Platform）平台後端服務，整合多系統 API（如 Agile PLM、Teamcenter）。
▶開發與維護前端介面（Vue 或 React），實現互動式 AI 查詢與資料視覺化。

【職務需求】
▶良好的溝通能力，能有效協作於跨部門團隊中
▶熟悉任一現代前端架構（Vue.js 或 React）。
▶熟悉 Node.js / Express / TypeScript 程式開發與後端架構設計。
▶熟悉 PostgreSQL 資料庫設計與查詢效能優化。
▶熟悉 Git / GitLab 版本控制操作。
▶熟悉 Linux 系統操作與部署環境設定。
▶熟悉 GitLab CI/CD 流程建置與維護。
▶熟悉 Docker / Docker Compose 容器化部署。
▶熟悉任一向量資料庫（如 Qdrant、FAISS、Milvus 等）。
▶熟悉 Ollama、vLLM 等推理服務 API 串接與應用。


【加分項目】
▶ 具 AI 系統或 RAG 架構開發經驗者優先錄取
▶對研發管理流程有深入理解或相關工作經驗
▶曾參與企業知識管理、AI 助手或文件搜尋專案
▶ 具備自主學習能力

■ 如需簽訂學校相關實習合約，請提前告知，並提供相關資料。

大慶證券於1988年成立，2003年成為上櫃公司，淨資產46.42億元。歷年來秉持「踏實穩健、正派經營」的經營理念，為客戶提供各種金融服務，除了證券交易，還包括投顧、承銷、自營、期貨、信用交易等業務。目前員工人數約400人，在全台灣共有12個營業據點，分佈於北區8處、中區2處、南區2處。併入亞洲價值資本集團後，全新的大慶證券整合了集團多元的金融服務能力，增加資產管理的服務，透過有競爭力的資產管理產品與專業可靠的投資顧問，為客戶與股東創造更多、更完整的價值。
於2022年我們更名為美好證券，英文名稱定為「GOOD FINANCE SECURITIES CO., LTD.」，這提醒我們「該追求的不只是富裕，而是美好，富裕只是工具」，全新品牌名稱將更貼近公司核心價值並強化發展願景。


【職位概述】
結合先進數據工程、分析與AI技術，致力於打造智能產品。藉由深度洞察，強化投資、產品與顧問核心能力。創造長期價值。將大數據分析轉化為可行洞察，提供即時與高品質的決策支持。持續支持公司數據化、AI化的運轉體系創新

身為 Data Engineer，負責設計、建置與維運 數據基礎設施 (Data Platform)，確保數據流通、處理與存取的自動化、穩定性與效能。透過高效的數據平台與自動化技術，提升數據應用價值，支持公司所有的數據、AI專案，支援公司業務增長、決策優化與 AI 應用。


【主要職責】
我們正在尋找細心、有責任感、熱愛數據並充滿好奇心的 Data Engineer，透過先進的數據工程，打造高效且可擴展的數據基礎建設，支持公司 DATA/AI 產品與服務的發展，並為內外部客戶提供高滿意的數據驅動成果，支持創造客戶、創造價值

1. 數據管線開發、監控與維護
- 設計、開發與維運 ETL / ELT Pipeline，收集整合內部與外部異質數據源，確保數據的品質、穩定性與可擴展性
- 數據建模 (Data Modeling)，確保數據架構符合業務需求與最佳實踐，提升查詢與運算效能
- 建立數據監控與告警機制 (Alerting & Monitoring)，確保數據管線穩定運行，即時偵測異常並優化數據流程

2. 數據產品開發與業務賦能
- 與各部門用戶 (User)、Data Scientist 深入合作，理解業務需求並設計適合的數據解決方案
- 設計並建置自動化商業分析 Dashboard 與追蹤系統，支持業務、產品發展與戰略決策，驅動數據產生商業價值

3. 數據平台 (Data Platform) 建置與維運
- 管理、部署與維護數據平台 (Data Platform)，確保高可用性與穩定性，支援 AI/數據產品開發
- 優化數據計算資源 (Spark, Presto…)，確保高效計算與儲存管理 (Data Lake, Data Warehouse)
- 建置數據治理 (Data Governance) 工具，確保數據質量、安全性與監管合規性

4. 數據系統監控與效能優化
- 數據遷移與架構優化：監測與分析數據系統與資料庫效能，進行數據遷移、性能調校與架構調整，確保系統穩定性與可擴展性。
- 優化查詢效能：縮短數據處理時間，提高系統查詢與運算效率
- 針對異常數據流或系統問題，提供有效的修復與最佳化方案

5.  MLOps / 數據工程 DevOps
- 與 Data Scientist 合作，部署與管理機器學習模型，確保模型能在生產環境穩定運行
- 建立與優化 MLOps 工作流程，提升模型的部署自動化、監控與維護，確保 AI 產品快速迭代
- 自動化數據與模型部署 (CI/CD)，確保數據工程與 AI 產品能夠穩定、高效地運行

【任職資格】
學經歷
- 學士以上，主修資訊工程、計算機科學、數據科學、應用數學、統計學、軟體工程或相關領域

- 具備金融數據應用經驗或相關證照尤佳

跨部門溝通與問題解決能力
- 具備良好溝通能力，能與 Data Scientist、跨部門團隊協作，推動數據應用落地
- 解決問題能力強，能針對數據異常、系統瓶頸進行診斷與優化

數據工程與管線技術
- 熟悉 ETL / ELT Pipeline 設計，能處理異質數據與 Batch / Streaming Data
- 熟悉SQL / NoSQL 數據庫 (PostgreSQL, MongoDB)
- 熟悉 Spark, Presto, Kafka 等大數據計算框架

監控、最佳化 DevOps/MLOps

- 熟悉 CI/CD、自動化數據部署
- 熟悉機器學習模型部署與 MLOps 流程，與Data Scientist 合作進行模型管理與監控


【我們提供】

job_description:
About the Team
The Spatial Intelligence CV group builds production-grade computer vision systems that power multimodal and spatially-aware products, from property imagery understanding to 3D scene analysis. We focus on delivering reliable, high-performance services—turning state-of-the-art vision models into scalable, user-facing products.

About the Role
You will design, optimize, and scale computer vision inference software running on both on-prem and cloud GPU clusters. Beyond writing production-quality Python, you will integrate advanced vision models into end-to-end pipelines that deliver real business value in domains such as architecture, real estate, and interior design. Your work will directly improve system accuracy, throughput, and cost efficiency.

In this role, you will
Build reusable Python inference pipelines for object detection, segmentation, and image generation at scale.

Implement and optimize training/inference flows for YOLO, U-Net, Segment Anything Model (SAM), and Stable Diffusion.

Fine-tune diffusion and LoRA-based models for domain-specific generation and augmentation.

Develop and integrate solutions in Novel View Synthesis, 6D Pose Estimation, Monocular Depth Estimation, Visual Question Answering (VQA), and Style Transfer.

Build Scene Graph pipelines to support space design, dimension measurement, and spatial understanding.

Conduct performance profiling and latency/throughput tuning for CV back-ends on GPU clusters.

Collaborate with product teams to deliver features such as automated property feature extraction, content tagging, and high-quality image synthesis.


You might thrive in this role if you
Enjoy turning cutting-edge CV and spatial reasoning research into robust, scalable production services.

Have experience across multiple vision tasks and can quickly adapt to new architectures.

Are motivated by measurable impact—accuracy gains, inference speedups, or improved user experience.

Communicate clearly with cross-functional stakeholders in Mandarin.


Minimum Qualifications
Master’s degree (or higher) in CS, EE, Applied Math, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

One or more academic or professional projects related to computer vision.

Hands-on experience with OpenCV, PyTorch, Git, Docker.

Practical experience with YOLO, U-Net, Segment Anything, and Stable Diffusion.

Familiarity with at least two of the following: Novel View Synthesis, 6D Pose Estimation, Monocular Depth Estimation, VQA, Style Transfer.

Understanding of Scene Graph concepts and their application in spatial reasoning tasks.


Bonus Qualifications
Experience in classification, segmentation, detection across various datasets.

Familiarity with ControlNet or other controllable generation techniques.

Publications in top-tier CV/AI conferences (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML).

Experience operating large-scale CV inference services with measurable performance metrics.

The Spatial Intelligence LLM group builds production-grade inference stacks that power next-generation conversational and multimodal experiences grounded in text and spatial data (imagery, maps, 3-D scenes). We focus on shipping reliable, high-performance services—turning proven techniques into robust, scalable products.

About the Role
You will design, optimize, and scale LLM inference software that runs on both on-prem and cloud GPU clusters. Beyond writing production-quality Python, you will work with platform engineers to integrate techniques. Your contributions will directly improve system latency, throughput, and cost efficiency.
In this role, you will
Build reusable Python inference pipelines serving chat, RAG, and VLM workloads at scale.

Conduct performance profiling and latency/throughput tuning for LLM back-ends (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton).

Track the latest developments in model architecture (e.g., Phi-3, Gemma, Qwen 2.5) and rapidly prototype optimizations with clear product impact.

Collaborate with product teams to deliver features such as hallucination mitigation, adaptive RAG pipelines, and agent services.

Provide feedback to infrastructure teams on GPU utilization, memory bandwidth, and batching strategies.
You might thrive in this role if you
Enjoy transforming ideas into production code that ships on a regular cadence.

Value clean abstractions (PEFT, TRL, vLLM) that enable fast experimentation.

Are motivated by measurable impact—milliseconds saved, tokens /sec gained, costs reduced.

Communicate clearly with cross-functional stakeholders in Mandarin.

Minimum Qualifications
Master’s degree (or higher) in CS, EE, Applied Math, or equivalent practical experience.

3+ years building and deploying deep-learning systems in Python.

Proficiency with PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem; solid software-engineering practices (tests, CI/CD, Docker).

Demonstrated knowledge of LLM internals (attention, KV caching, quantization) and modern inference frameworks (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton).
Bonus Qualifications

Publications or technical blogs on practical LLM deployment or optimization.

Experience operating large-scale production ML services with SLO/SLI ownership.

We are seeking an expert AI Platform & Agent Architect to lead the design, implementation, and operationalization of GPU-based LLM infrastructure, secure AI Gateway systems, and orchestrated multi-agent workflows. 6. Establish LLMOps & MLOps best practices: model versioning, GPU utilization tracking, CI/CD pipelines, and observability (leveraging OpenTelemetry for metrics, traces, and logs).
7. Integrate enterprise-grade authentication (SSO/OAuth) and enforce governance, context-level access control across Gateway and MCP layers.

【Basic Qualifications】
1. Proven experience building AI Gateways: secure routing, token management, failover, rate limit, and observability.
2. Hands-on with MCP server/client architecture: context specification, JSON-RPC session handling, tool negotiation.
3. Strong track record designing multi-agent systems with coordinated tool use and shared context delivery.
4. Expert knowledge in GPU-based LLM inference and orchestration (Kubernetes, CI/CD, inference engines).
5. Experience building Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines and integrating vector databases.
6. Solid LLMOps/MLOps background—model lifecycle management, observability, deployment automation.
7. Excellent collaboration and communication skills for cross-functional system architecture work.

【Preferred Qualifications】
1. Familiarity with security and governance for MCP/gateway layers: session scoping, prompt injection mitigation, permission modeling.
2. Proven skills in prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, and inference optimization.
3. Prior experience building internal AI platforms or model registries.

We are looking for a highly motivated and skilled AI Infrastructure Engineer with strong hands-on experience in Kubernetes (K8s), particularly in supporting AI/ML workflows. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing, implementing, and maintaining robust, scalable, and high-performance Kubernetes-based infrastructure that supports the entire lifecycle of our AI applications—from data processing and model training to deployment and monitoring. You will work closely with data scientists, AI/ML engineers, and DevOps teams to ensure seamless integration of AI/ML workloads within cloud-native environments. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of container orchestration, distributed systems, and MLOps practices, and is passionate about building efficient, reliable platforms that enable rapid AI innovation. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of AI and cloud infrastructure, contributing to next-generation systems that power intelligent applications at scale.

<Job Responsibilities>

．Design & Architecture: Design, build, and scale a reliable and efficient Kubernetes platform optimized for AI/ML workloads. This includes provisioning GPUs, managing resources, and ensuring optimal performance for computationally intensive tasks.
．Infrastructure Management: Manage the entire Kubernetes cluster lifecycle—from provisioning and configuration to ongoing maintenance, monitoring, and troubleshooting, ensuring high availability and scalability.
．Deployment & Automation: Develop and implement CI/CD pipelines to automate the deployment, scaling, and updating of machine learning models and AI services. Ensure seamless integration with AI tools like Kubeflow, MLflow, and Argo Workflows.
．Performance Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize system performance, focusing on resource utilization, latency reduction, and improving the overall efficiency of AI workloads. Ensure high availability and minimal downtime for AI services.
．Collaboration & Guidance: Work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, and cross-functional teams to understand their infrastructure requirements and provide technical solutions to meet workload demands effectively.
．Security & Compliance: Implement best practices for cluster security, including network policies, access controls, and vulnerability management to safeguard sensitive data and maintain compliance.
．Cost & Resource Efficiency: Manage resources effectively to optimize cost while maintaining high-performance infrastructure for AI model training, inference, and data processing.

 

<Skills & Qualifications>

．Kubernetes Expertise: You should have hands-on experience with Kubernetes (K8s) architecture, including deploying applications, managing resources, and troubleshooting complex cluster issues in a production environment.
．Containerization & Linux Environment: Strong knowledge of container technologies such as Docker, along with hands-on experience in Linux environments. Expertise in container orchestration and deployment practices is highly valued.
．AI Workloads: Deep understanding of GPU scheduling and performance optimization, including strategies for resource allocation, workload balancing, and maximizing throughput for AI/ML tasks.
．Automation & CI/CD: You need practical experience with building and managing CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or ArgoCD to automate deployments.
．Programming & Scripting: Proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., Python, Bash) is a must.
．Networking: Knowledge of container networking and service mesh technologies (e.g., Istio, Linkerd) is highly desirable and a great advantage.

【職位摘要】

我們正在尋找一位充滿熱情且具備一年以上經驗的 AI 軟體工程師。這個職位的核心任務是負責企業客戶私有化 AI 應用服務的導入與建置。

您將與專業的 AI 研發團隊密切合作，在技術轉移的過程中，扮演共同開發者的關鍵角色。您不僅是技術的接收者，更是將尖端 AI 模型與演算法，成功落地到客戶環境並解決實際業務痛點的推動者。如果您對大型語言模型 (LLM)、生成式 AI 以及將 AI 技術應用於真實商業場景充滿熱情，並樂於接受跨領域的挑戰，我們誠摯地邀請您加入。

【工作職責】

1. 協同技術轉移與開發：
　• 作為技術轉移的核心成員，與 AI 專家團隊共同開發，深入理解並掌握最新的 AI 模型、演算法及解決方案架構。
　• 將技術知識轉化為可在客戶私有環境中部署、穩定運行的應用服務。

2. 私有化 AI 應用建置：
　• 參與客戶需求的訪談與分析，設計並實作符合客戶場景的私有化 AI 解決方案。
　• 負責在客戶指定的本地伺服器或私有雲環境中，完成 AI 應用的部署、整合與測試。
　• 確保系統的安全性、穩定性與效能，符合企業級服務標準。

3. 模型導入與優化：
　• 協助進行 AI 模型的部署，並根據客戶的特定數據與反饋，進行必要的微調 (Fine-tuning) 與優化。
　• 整合與開發相關 API，使 AI 服務能與客戶現有的企業系統 (如 ERP, CRM) 無縫對接。

4. 技術支援與文件撰寫：
　• 在專案導入期間，提供客戶即時的技術支援與問題排解。
　• 撰寫清晰的技術文件、部署手冊與維運指南，以利後續的維護與知識傳承。

5. 出差與客戶溝通：
　• 需不定期至客戶端進行國內出差，以進行系統建置、會議和技術交流。

【必要條件】
　• 具備 1 年以上軟體開發相關工作經驗。
　• 熟悉至少一種主流程式語言，如 Python、Java 或 Go。
　• 對 AI/ML 領域有基礎知識，了解機器學習、深度學習或大型語言模型 (LLM) 的基本原理。
　• 具備 Linux 環境操作與腳本撰寫 (Shell Script) 的能力。
　• 擁有良好的團隊合作精神與溝通能力，能與不同背景的技術專家協同工作。
　• 願意接受挑戰，具備快速學習新技術的熱情與能力。
　
【為什麼要加入我們？】

　• 站在 AI 技術最前線：您將有機會接觸並實作業界最先進的企業級 AI 應用，而非僅止於理論研究。
　• 專業團隊與完整培訓：我們將與專業的 AI 研發團隊合作，將提供系統性的技術轉移與指導，讓您在專案中快速成長。
　• 創造真實影響力：您的工作將直接幫助各行各業的龍頭企業實現 AI 轉型，解決其核心的商業痛點。

這不僅是一次技術上的巨大挑戰，更是一次顛覆傳統商業模式的機會，讓您在職業生涯中擁有極具代表性的成就，親身推動整個產業的數位化進程的創舉。

在這裡，您不只是撰寫基礎架構或自動化管道，更是在解決碎片化市場與庫存風險的核心戰場：

從 0 到 1 的端到端實踐：設計高可用 RabbitMQ/Kafka 事件流，打造 Kubernetes 上的 CI/CD Pipeline，並將 AI 協作工具（Perplexity MCP、Copilot、Codex、Cursor）融入日常開發。

  ✦在 Kubernetes (GKE/AKS/EKS) 或 VM 環境中部署、管理微服務、Ingress、NetworkPolicy、TLS／SSL、負載平衡。

  ✦規劃並實作 Jenkins / GitLab CI / GitHub Actions 自動化流程：

  ✦自動化部署至 Development → Staging → Production
  ✦撰寫自動化健康檢查、Smoke Test 腳本，並可選整合 AI 測試助手，加速回饋迴圈。

  ✦設定告警（Alertmanager、PagerDuty、Slack 通知）：佇列積壓、消費失敗、Pod CrashLoop、資源異常。

⌖輔助工具與 SDK 開發
  ✦開發輕量級 CLI 或 SDK：MQ 管理工具、K8s 部署輔助腳本、Metrics Exporter、Health Check Service。

電腦視覺與人工智慧領域之研發工程師，將專注於深度學習演算法的研究、設計、開發與專案落地，應用範圍涵蓋但不限於：異常檢測、影像分類、物件檢測與分割、姿態估計、智慧影像分析等。 職責包含：

• 配置、監控和故障排除系統整合，確保資料流的準確性和效率。

整合管理 (Integration Management)

• 確保整合流程的可重用性和優化，以最大程度地降低營運成本。
• 與 IT 和業務利害關係人合作，維護資料安全和行業標準的合規性。
行業應用 (Industry Application)
• 將物流和貨運代理的營運需求轉化為技術規格。
• 支援貨物可視性、海關合規性和供應鏈事件的資料交換。

跨國溝通 (Cross-Border Communication)
• 與海外辦事處、客戶和承運人協調系統測試與上線活動 (go-live activities)。
• 為技術和業務團隊提供雙語支援（中文和英文）。

We are seeking a Data Exchange Specialist to join our team and support the integration and execution of data exchange processes within the freight forwarding, transportation, and supply chain logistics sectors. The ideal candidate will bring both technical expertise and industry knowledge, ensuring seamless communication between systems, partners, and clients across global operations.

Data Exchange Execution
• Manage and maintain data exchange processes, including EDI, API, XML, and SFTP communications.
• Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot system integrations to ensure accuracy and efficiency in data flow.
• Execute onboarding of new trading partners and support client system connections.

Integration Management
• Work with integration platforms (preferably Boomi) to design, implement, and support automated workflows.
• Ensure reusability and optimization of integration processes to minimize operational costs.
• Collaborate with IT and business stakeholders to maintain compliance with data security and industry standards.

Industry Application
• Translate logistics and freight forwarding operational requirements into technical specifications.
• Support shipment visibility, customs compliance, and supply chain event data exchange.
• Provide subject matter expertise in logistics data formats (e.g., ANSI X12, EDIFACT, IATA, FMC/CBP standards).

Cross-Border Communication
• Coordinate with overseas offices, clients, and carriers for system testing and go-live activities.
• Provide bilingual support (Chinese & English) for both technical and business teams.

job_description:
Job Title: AI Compiler Engineer

Job Description:
Overview:
We are seeking a skilled and motivated AI Compiler Engineer to lead the development of our AI compiler for the Neural Processing Unit (NPU). As part of our team, you will play a critical role in transforming high-level neural network workloads (such as CNNs and transformer models) into efficient machine code that maximizes inference performance, minimizes power consumption, and optimizes memory usage.

Responsibilities:
1. Compiler Development:
• Design and develop an AI compiler that translates high-level neural network descriptions (in frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, or ONNX) into optimized machine code for the NPU.
• Implement parsing algorithms to analyze neural network graphs and extract relevant information for compilation.
2. Optimization Strategies:
• Optimize the computational graph by applying techniques such as operator fusion, kernel selection, and memory layout transformations.
• Minimize inference time, reduce power consumption, and optimize memory footprint through intelligent code generation.
3. Performance Profiling and Analysis:
• Profile compiled code to identify bottlenecks and areas for improvement.
• Collaborate with hardware architects to understand NPU microarchitecture and tailor optimizations accordingly.
4. Code Generation and Lowering:
• Generate efficient machine code from the intermediate representation of neural network operations.
• Ensure compatibility with the NPU's instruction set architecture.
5. Integration and Testing:
• Integrate the AI compiler into the overall software stack, including runtime libraries and drivers.
• Develop test suites to validate correctness, performance, and compatibility across various neural network models.
6. Documentation and Communication:
• Document design decisions, algorithms, and implementation details.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including hardware engineers, software developers, and researchers.

Qualifications:
• Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
• Minimum of 3 years of experience in compiler development, preferably with exposure to AI or machine learning.
• Proficiency in C/C++/Python programming and familiarity with compiler construction.
• Knowledge of neural network frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.) and their intermediate representations.
• Experience with performance profiling tools and optimization techniques.
• Understanding of machine learning concepts and hardware architectures.
• Familiarity with data structures, optimization algorithms, and DevOps tools (such as Git, CI/CD pipelines).
• Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
• Excellent communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Skills:
• Familiarity with deep learning frameworks and libraries.
• Knowledge of hardware acceleration technologies and frameworks.
• Experience of tensor computation and optimization.
• Previous work in compiler for CPU, GPU, DSP, NPU is a plus.

If you are passionate about compiler engineering, AI optimization, and want to be part of a team driving innovation, we encourage you to apply. Join us in shaping the future of AI acceleration.

Provide technical expertise and guidance to cross-functional teams.
Documentation:

Create clear and comprehensive documentation for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Qualifications:

Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
Proven experience in developing and optimizing generative AI models.
Solid understanding of Neural Processing Unit (NPU) architecture and hardware constraints.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or C++.
Experience with model compression, quantization, and other optimization techniques.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a collaborative team environment.
Preferred Skills:

Familiarity with deep learning frameworks and libraries.
Knowledge of hardware acceleration technologies and frameworks.
Experience with parallel computing and distributed systems.
Previous work on AI applications in computer vision, natural language processing, or speech recognition is a plus.
If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI optimization on NPU hardware and want to be part of a team driving innovation, we encourage you to apply. Join us in shaping the future of generative AI applications.

Publications in top-tier CV/AI conferences (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML).

job_title: [專案二部]GAI應用工程師
company: 人工智能股份有限公司
job_description:
▍職務說明
我們正在尋找邏輯清晰、對 AI 技術應用有熱情的夥伴加入團隊。 本職位的主要任務，是將公司現有的 NLP 與生成式 AI 產品（如：智能客服、RAG 知識庫系統）成功導入至客戶的場域中。此職位不需要從頭訓練模型，但需要熟悉產品特性及「提示詞工程 （Prompt Engineering）」，協助客戶解決實際的業務問題。

▍工作內容 
1. 專案需求分析與導入規劃
• 理解公司 AI 產品功能，針對客戶（如政府機關、企業）需求，規劃可實現的解決方案。
• 分析客戶的業務流程，將模糊的需求轉化為具體的系統規格與對話邏輯。
• 繪製對話流程圖，規劃使用者與 AI 的互動路徑。
• 與工程團隊、專案經理密切協作，確保系統功能與 AI 回應策略符合客戶期待。
2. 提示詞工程（Prompt Engineering） 與成效優化
• 根據專案場景設計 Prompt，引導 LLM 產出符合語氣與規範的回覆。
• 進行 AI 回覆品質的測試與調校，修正邏輯錯誤或幻覺。
• 定期檢視對話紀錄，針對回答不佳的案例進行分析與改善。
3. 知識工程 （Knowledge Base） 建置與優化
• 協助客戶梳理大量文本資料（FAQ、手冊、規章），建立結構化的知識庫分類。
• 規劃 RAG 知識庫資料架構，提升 AI 檢索準確度。
4. 系統測試與交付
• 執行系統整合測試 （SIT） 與使用者驗收測試 （UAT）。
• 撰寫測試案例，驗證 AI 在各種情境下的回答表現。
• 製作標準化專案文件（如：系統規格書、操作手冊、測試報告）。
• 擔任講師進行教育訓練，指導客戶如何操作後台與維護知識庫。

▍條件要求
必要條件 （Must Have）
1. 邏輯思維：能將複雜的資訊拆解成明確且好理解的流程圖或架構圖。
2. Prompt Engineering ：熟悉 LLM 模型特性（如 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 等)，具備結構化 Prompt 撰寫與迭代優化的實務經驗。能運用 System Prompt、Few-shot Learning、Chain-of-Thought 等技巧，精準控制 AI 回覆品質並降低幻覺現象。
3. 溝通協調能力：能用淺顯易懂的方式向客戶說明技術內容，也能精準傳達客戶需求給工程師。
4. 文件撰寫能力：熟悉 Word、Excel、PowerPoint，能產出高品質的規格文件與簡報。
加分條件 （Nice to Have）
1. 具備 1 年以上智能客服（Chatbot）、或知識庫管理等 AI 專案導入經驗。
2. 具備 UI/UX 使用者體驗概念，能提出改善介面或使用者流程的建議。
3. 具備基礎程式能力（如:Python、JavaScript），或網頁、API 概念，有助於理解系統運作與工程師溝通。
4. 科系不拘，歡迎資訊管理、圖書資訊、數位內容、語言學或資訊傳播背景，以及所有對科技應用充滿熱忱的夥伴加入。

job_title: 電子紙色彩演算法研發工程師
company: 達擎股份有限公司
job_description:
職務目標
負責電子紙顯示器之色彩演算法設計與優化，包含色彩空間轉換、校正/匹配、驅動序列策略與影像處理，確保在不同環境與面板條件下，達到準確色彩、穩定輸出與高效能。

主要工作內容
一、色彩演算法研發
建構與實作色彩空間轉換（RGB/CMYK/XYZ/Lab 等）與 ΔE 色差最小化策略。
設計 Gamma/灰階校正、去色偏（white point/black point 調整）與抑制殘影（ghosting）演算法。
針對多色電子紙（如三色/四色/彩色微膠囊）設計 驅動序列與波形優化。
二、影像處理與效能優化
針對電子紙刷新特性，開發 抖動/誤差擴散、邊緣保護、對比提升等演算法。
使用 SIMD/GPU（CUDA/OpenCL）或固定小數（fixed-point）進行效能與記憶體優化。
三、量測與校色流程
建置量測流程（色度計/分光儀），建立/維護 ICC Profile 與面板校色資料庫。
分析批次差異與老化行為，制定 補償模型（溫度/電壓/老化因子）。
四、跨部門協作
與硬體/韌體團隊合作整合驅動與演算法；與 產品/PM 對齊需求與時程。
撰寫設計規範、測試計畫與技術文件，支援量產導入與客戶技術交流。
五、實驗與問題解決
規劃 DOE（實驗設計），定位色偏、殘影、刷新時間過長等問題根因。
追蹤並比較同業技術與學術研究，提出改良方案與專利建議。
job_categories: 演算法工程師
other_conditions:

2.數學/演算法基礎：線性代數、數值分析、最佳化方法（如 least squares、nonlinear optimization）。 
3. 色彩與影像知識：了解色彩科學（Lab/XYZ、色差 ΔE）、Gamma/灰階、抖動與濾波。

About the role...

We are seeking an exceptionally talented and driven Business Analyst to join our Business Intelligence (BI) team. In this role, you will be a key player in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling our business stakeholders to make informed, strategic decisions. You'll work closely with various departments across the organization, from operations and finance to sales and product, to understand their data needs, design robust reporting solutions, and drive a data-driven culture. If you have a passion for data, a knack for telling stories with numbers, and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, this is the role for you.


What you will do...

1. Stakeholder Collaboration & Needs Assessment: 
Partner with business leaders and end-users across all departments to understand their reporting, dashboard, and analytical requirements. Translate business questions into technical specifications for data extraction and visualization.

2. Data Modeling & Analysis: 
Collaborate with data engineers to define and refine data models, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and usability for BI purposes. Conduct in-depth data analysis using SQL and other tools to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies.

3. Report & Dashboard Development: 
Design, develop, and maintain compelling and intuitive dashboards, reports, and visualizations using BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI). Ensure reports are accurate, timely, and meet the specific needs of the users.

4. Data Quality & Governance: 
Work closely with data engineering and source system owners to ensure data quality, integrity, and governance standards are met. Identify and resolve data discrepancies.
Performance Monitoring & Optimization: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) relevant to various business functions. Monitor report and dashboard performance, making recommendations for optimization and improvements.

5. Training & Support: 
Provide training and support to business users on how to effectively use BI tools and interpret data insights. Foster data literacy across the organization.

6. Process Improvement: 
Identify opportunities to automate reporting processes and improve the efficiency of data delivery.

7. Ad-Hoc Analysis: 
Conduct ad-hoc data analysis to answer specific business questions and support strategic initiatives.

8. Documentation: 
Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for data models, reports, dashboards, and BI processes.


Who you are...

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders and translate business needs into technical requirements.
- Proactive, self-motivated, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
- A strong passion for data, curiosity, and a commitment to continuous learning.


What Skills are required...

- 3+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, BI Analyst, Data Analyst, or similar role with a strong focus on business intelligence and reporting.
- Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with a proven ability to extract meaningful insights from large and complex datasets.
- Expert proficiency in SQL for data querying, manipulation, and analysis.
- Extensive experience with at least one major BI tool (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI, QlikView/Sense) for dashboard and report development.
- Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling.
- Experience in the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry is a plus.
- Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS Redshift, Google BigQuery, Snowflake).
- Experience with scripting languages for data processing (e.g., Python, R).
- Knowledge of statistical analysis concepts.
- Experience with data governance best practices is a plus.

打造XQ 的量化交易功能，讓投資人能夠掌握市場先機、提升交易體驗，正是我們的主要任務之一 !

1. 金融市場的量化交易系統的開發和建置

3. 金融資料的整理和分析

熟悉C++

◆ 活出「嘉實」，找到值得追求的企業願景 ◆

「嘉」，為善、幸福之意。投資不再讓少數人專美於前，我們矢志打造更便捷並讓分析資料更易取得的投資平台，為每個人及每個家庭找到專屬的理財規劃。

「實」，為實在、不造作之意。嘉實人做七分、講五分，以最真誠負責的態度研發每一項產品，並投入承諾做到最好。


◆ 產品創新，收入穩定成長 ◆

嘉實自創業累積超過20年專業經驗，於近期推出全台第一個自製的量化交易平台。連續10年股東權益報酬率都大於15%，上市櫃公司能達到此一標準者共只有36家；連續16年營收成長，上市櫃公司中能達到此一標準者只有4家。


◆ 以人為善，像家人般傾心相待 ◆

我們彼此信任，對於公司發展、產品規劃資訊從不藏私；我們相互扶持，設有職涯與身心諮詢機制，安排專屬peer與buddy一同學習成長；我們共享喜悅，每年不定期舉辦產品慶功與年節聚會、餐敘，創造和夥伴們的連結與互動。


◆ 友善職場，體驗最自在溫馨的工作環境與企業文化 ◆ 

重視工作與生活間的平衡，制定較彈性的上班工時與較寬鬆且優於勞基法的休假制度，同時備有專屬人體工學椅、豐盛零食與自動咖啡機等等，提供夥伴們適度的休閒空間，療癒身心並補充精力。


◆ 如果你也喜歡投資，就別猶豫了，快來開啟你的斜槓人生 ◆ 

在嘉實，公司開發的產品都能免費使用，每位夥伴都是產品使用者，更是產品的發想者。我們不定時邀請財經專家，舉辦投資講座相互分享切磋，快帶著你對投資理財的熱忱，和對財富自由的嚮往，與一群志同道合的同伴相遇吧!

▪️Holds a Master’s degree or has equivalent hands-on experience.
▪️Has experience with machine learning frameworks(e.g., PyTorch, HuggingFace, PyTorch Lightning).
▪️Is comfortable coding in Python, and familiar with SQL, Git, and Web API tools like Flask or FastAPI.
▪️Has experience working on machine learning projects — from experimentation to deployment.
▪️Enjoys working in a team and communicates ideas clearly and effectively.
If you’re curious, hands-on, and always up for a new challenge — that’s a big plus!

▶About the Job◀
Hi! We’re the DCS Team(Department of Cognition and Sensing)— a vibrant group of machine learning engineers, data scientists, and software architects who love exploring new ideas and building meaningful solutions with AI.
We work on cutting-edge machine learning applications, especially in the areas of Computer Vision(CV)and Multi-modal AI. Whether it’s extracting key data from documents, generating image captions, or building smart visual search systems — we’re passionate about bringing intelligence into daily workflows and helping people save time and energy.
Our team culture is open, experimental, and supportive. We’re not afraid to try new things, break stuff, and celebrate wins — big or small. You'll get the chance to work on real-world problems, collaborate across teams, and see your ideas come to life in products used by real customers.

▶Our Focus Areas◀
We work on:
▪️Visual Document Understanding(VDU)
Extracting meaningful data from complex documents like receipts, invoices, and contracts.
▪️Key Information Extraction(KIE)
Pulling out key details like names, dates, and prices from scanned or digital documents.
▪️Image Captioning
Teaching machines to describe what they see — helpful for accessibility, search, and context.
▪️Visual Search(Multi-RAG)
Enabling smart search experiences by combining image and text queries.
▪️Visual Question Answering(VQA)
Answering questions about visual content, combining CV and natural language understanding.
▪️Multi-modal Applications
Building systems that integrate multiple inputs — like image + text — to solve complex tasks.
We collaborate closely with other business teams to explore real-world use cases, deliver solutions, and iterate quickly. You’ll also have the opportunity to attend tech conferences, study SOTA papers, and share what you learn with our internal community.

▶What Your Day-to-Day Might Look Like◀
Life at DCS is a mix of research and engineering
Some days, you’ll feel like a researcher: reading papers, designing experiments, preparing datasets, or testing new model architectures. Other days, you’ll be deep into engineering work — building internal frameworks, packaging models into APIs, and deploying models at scale.
Here’s a brief overview of our daily rhythm:
▪️Small, mission-based squads working on different goals(VDU, visual search, etc.), with lots of cross-team collaboration.
▪️Warm-up meetings to sync up on goals, share progress, and ask for support.
▪️Journal clubs to discuss the latest research, tools, or techniques.
▪️Demos and retros to present your work and reflect on what’s working.
⭐We love building, sharing, and growing together — both technically and personally.

▶Responsibilities◀
As part of the DCS team, you’ll:
▪️Design and build ML-powered solutions — from model training to wrapping them into APIs.
▪️Stay updated on the latest SOTA research and apply novel ideas in real-world scenarios.
▪️Collaborate with other business teams to design ML-driven features that meet customer needs.
▪️Optimize and deploy models to run efficiently across various environments — including on-prem devices and cloud infrastructure.

Ready to join us and build smarter things together?
We’d love to hear from you — whether you’re passionate about machine learning, excited about vision or multi-modal challenges, or simply curious about what we’re building at DCS. Let’s talk :)

job_description:
We are looking for a passionate and detail-oriented NLP Engineer to join our team. This is a full-stack data role, covering every step from collecting raw data to delivering production-ready datasets for AI waifu training. You will work on processing, refining, and managing large-scale text, voice, and image datasets to train anime-inspired AI companions—specifically waifus—for our product, darlin™ (www.darlin.ai). 

Responsibilities
1. Full-Stack Data Pipeline Management: Manage the complete data lifecycle — collecting, storing, augmenting, training, cleaning, refining, and retrieving — for large-scale text, voice, and image datasets.
2. Dataset Curation & Structuring: Organize and annotate datasets according to personality traits, emotional tone, and dialogue style.
3. User-Generated Data Integration: Gather and process user-generated data from darlin™ to refine and enhance AI waifu behavior, personality, and tone authenticity.
4. Multilingual Data Processing: Refine, translate, and align datasets across Japanese, English, Chinese, and other languages.
5. Data Augmentation: Expand and diversify datasets using NLP augmentation, AI rewriting, paraphrasing, and cross-lingual adaptation.
6. Model Pretraining & Instruct Tuning: Apply Transformer architectures, pretraining (not fine-tuning), instruct tuning, and prompt engineering for personality-driven dialogue.
7. Advanced Retrieval Systems: Implement and optimize vector similarity search, RAG, and Self-RAG for contextual recall.
8. Speech & Singing Data: Prepare datasets for TTS, ASR, speech language models, and singing synthesis.
9. Data Infrastructure & Acquisition: Build pipelines using databases, web scraping, and search tools within IP/licensing compliance.
10. Model Serving & Optimization: Quantization, token tuning, context window management, KV caching, attention adjustments, streaming, and dummy token handling.
11. Clustering & NLP Data Analysis: Use common NLP-related techniques such as K-means clustering, NER (Named Entity Recognition), sentiment analysis, keyword extraction, topic modeling etc..
12. Prompt Optimization: Design, test, and refine prompt templates to control AI waifu behavior and tone.
13. Research & Innovation: Read AI/NLP research papers to apply new concepts to AI waifu personality and realism.

情熱と細部へのこだわりを持つNLPエンジニアを募集しています。本ポジションはフルスタックデータ業務であり、生データ収集からAI彼女の学習用本番データセットの提供まで全工程を担当します。darlin™ (www.darlin.ai) において、テキスト・音声・画像の大規模データを処理・精緻化・管理し、アニメ風AI彼女の会話、口調、スタイルを一貫性・本物感・原作準拠で実現することがミッションです。

業務内容
1. フルスタックデータパイプライン管理： 収集、保存、拡張、学習、クリーニング、精緻化、検索まで全データライフサイクルを担当。
2. データセット構築・構造化： 性格特性・感情トーン・会話スタイルに基づき整理・アノテーション。
3. ユーザー生成データ活用： darlin™ のユーザーデータを収集・処理し、AI彼女の行動・個性・口調を改善。
4. 多言語データ処理： 日本語・英語・中国語などでのデータ翻訳・整合。
5. データ拡張： NLP拡張、AI書き換え、パラフレーズ、クロスリンガル変換。
6. モデル事前学習・インストラクションチューニング： Transformerアーキテクチャ、事前学習、Instruct Tuning、プロンプトエンジニアリング。
7. 高度な検索システム： ベクトル類似検索、RAG、Self-RAGの実装・最適化。
8. 音声・歌声データ： TTS、ASR、音声言語モデル、歌声合成用データの準備。
9. データ基盤構築： データベース、スクレイピング、検索ツールの利用（IP/ライセンス遵守）。
10. モデル提供・最適化： 量子化、トークン調整、コンテキストウィンドウ管理、KVキャッシュ、Attention調整、ストリーミング、ダミートークン処理。
11. クラスタリングとNLPデータ分析： K-meansクラスタリング、NER（固有表現抽出）、感情分析、キーワード抽出、トピックモデリング etc..
12. プロンプト最適化： テンプレ設計・テスト・改善で行動・口調を制御。
13. 研究・イノベーション： AI/NLP論文を活用し、AI彼女の個性・リアリズム向上。

job_description:
【關於我們】

我們是一家不斷追求創新的領先旅行社。在數位時代，我們深信「數據」是引領我們航向未來的羅盤。我們致力於將龐雜的旅遊數據——從航班動態、飯店預訂到客戶行為軌跡——轉化為驅動決策的洞見與創造個人化體驗的魔法。為此，我們正在尋找一位數據領域的築夢師，與我們一同打造堅實、智慧的數據基石。

【這個角色為何關鍵？】

您將是我們數據驅動策略的核心架構師。您所建構的每一條 Data Pipeline，都將成為公司營運的動脈，穩定地輸送著決策所需的血液。您參與的每一個機器學習專案，都可能催生出下一個顛覆市場的旅遊產品或服務。您的工作將直接賦能市場、產品、營運等團隊，讓我們的決策更精準，服務更貼心。

工作內容 (Key Responsibilities)
1. 數據管道 (Data Pipeline) 的設計與開發：
主導使用 Apache Airflow 設計、開發、部署與維護可擴展、高效率的自動化數據工作流 (DAGs)。
負責從多元數據源（包含內部資料庫、第三方旅遊供應商 API、網站使用者行為 Log、行銷平台數據等）進行數據提取 (Ingestion)、轉換 (Transformation) 與載入 (ETL/ELT)。
確保數據的品質、完整性與一致性，並建立完善的監控與警報機制。
2. 專案性機器學習 (ML) 開發與整合：
跨部門合作，挖掘具商業價值的機器學習應用場景。
負責機器學習專案中的數據前處理、特徵工程 (Feature Engineering)、模型訓練與驗證。
協助將訓練好的模型部署到生產環境，並與現有系統整合。
3. 數據基礎設施與架構優化：
參與數據倉儲 (Data Warehouse) 或數據湖 (Data Lake) 的架構設計與效能調校。
與後端工程師協作，確保數據收集與儲存的效率與規範。
探索並導入新興的數據技術與工具，持續提升團隊的數據處理能力。

job_description:
▶ About the Job
Hi! We’re the DLII Team (Department of Linguistic Intelligence and Interaction) — a passionate group of machine learning engineers and researchers exploring how language models can make technology more natural, capable, and useful.
Our mission is to bring cutting-edge LLM and agent technologies into real-world business applications. From empowering language models with agent-related abilities such as reasoning and tool calling, we’re constantly pushing the boundaries of what machines can understand and do.
If you’re excited about shaping the next generation of language-driven agents, you’ll fit right in.

▶ Our Focus Areas
We work on a range of projects at the intersection of SOTA research and real-world business problems. Some of our current focuses include:
▪️ LLM Enhancement
Improving small and medium-scale LLMs through technologies like Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT), reinforcement learning, and domain adaptation — enabling them to different domain and use-case needs.
▪️ Agent Systems & Applications
Designing LLM-based agents capable of multi-step reasoning and tool-calling, and building flexible agent frameworks that our business units can adapt to their unique workflows.
▪️ Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Building and refining pipelines that ground models with accurate, context-aware retrieval, including embedding, reranking, and knowledge integration.
▪️ Core NLP Research & Infrastructure
While our focus is on LLMs and agents, we still draw on our NLP foundation — from NER, summarization, and knowledge graph building, to document understanding — to strengthen our systems’ capabilities from multiple angles.

▶ What Your Day-to-Day Might Look Like
At DLII, every day brings a mix of research exploration and engineering craftsmanship. You might be optimizing model performance, experimenting with new training techniques, or transforming prototypes into production-ready systems that drive real business value.
Here’s a glimpse of what you might do:
▪️ Collaborate in small, agile team focusing on specific goals like RAG optimization or agent reasoning.
▪️ Package and deploy models as APIs or microservices for internal and external projects.
▪️ Participate in paper-reading sessions, demos, and retros to share findings and refine approaches.
▪️ Work closely with product teams to integrate intelligent agent systems into real-world workflows.

▶ Responsibilities
As part of the DLII team, you’ll:
▪️ Design, develop, and deploy LLM- and agent-powered solutions that bridge research and application.
▪️ Conduct applied research to explore novel architectures and training methods for LLMs.
▪️ Build and optimize pipelines for agent tasks.
▪️ Collaborate across teams to tailor solutions that align with business goals.
▪️ Deploy and optimize models across local and cloud-based environments.

▶ Why Join Us
At DLII, we believe innovation comes from curiosity and collaboration. You’ll get to:
⭐ Work on real-world LLM and agent challenges with measurable business impact.
⭐ Attend industry conferences and study the latest research together with teammates.
⭐ Share your ideas in an open, supportive environment that celebrates learning and experimentation.
We’re here to build intelligent systems that understand, reason, and help people — and we’d love for you to be part of that journey.

▶ About the Job
Hi! We’re the DLII Team (Department of Linguistic Intelligence and Interaction) — a passionate group of machine learning engineers and researchers exploring how language models can make technology more natural, capable, and useful.
Our mission is to bring cutting-edge LLM and agent technologies into real-world business applications. From empowering language models with agent-related abilities such as reasoning and tool calling, we’re constantly pushing the boundaries of what machines can understand and do.
If you’re excited about shaping the next generation of language-driven agents, you’ll fit right in.

▶ Our Focus Areas
We work on a range of projects at the intersection of SOTA research and real-world business problems. Some of our current focuses include:
▪️ LLM Enhancement
Improving small and medium-scale LLMs through technologies like Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT), reinforcement learning, and domain adaptation — enabling them to different domain and use-case needs.
▪️ Agent Systems & Applications
Designing LLM-based agents capable of multi-step reasoning and tool-calling, and building flexible agent frameworks that our business units can adapt to their unique workflows.
▪️ Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Building and refining pipelines that ground models with accurate, context-aware retrieval, including embedding, reranking, and knowledge integration.
▪️ Core NLP Research & Infrastructure
While our focus is on LLMs and agents, we still draw on our NLP foundation — from NER, summarization, and knowledge graph building, to document understanding — to strengthen our systems’ capabilities from multiple angles.

▶ What Your Day-to-Day Might Look Like
At DLII, every day brings a mix of research exploration and engineering craftsmanship. You might be optimizing model performance, experimenting with new training techniques, or transforming prototypes into production-ready systems that drive real business value.
Here’s a glimpse of what you might do:
▪️ Collaborate in small, agile team focusing on specific goals like RAG optimization or agent reasoning.
▪️ Package and deploy models as APIs or microservices for internal and external projects.
▪️ Participate in paper-reading sessions, demos, and retros to share findings and refine approaches.
▪️ Work closely with product teams to integrate intelligent agent systems into real-world workflows.

▶ Responsibilities
As part of the DLII team, you’ll:
▪️ Design, develop, and deploy LLM- and agent-powered solutions that bridge research and application.
▪️ Conduct applied research to explore novel architectures and training methods for LLMs.
▪️ Build and optimize pipelines for agent tasks.
▪️ Collaborate across teams to tailor solutions that align with business goals.
▪️ Deploy and optimize models across local and cloud-based environments.

▶ Why Join Us
At DLII, we believe innovation comes from curiosity and collaboration. You’ll get to:
⭐ Work on real-world LLM and agent challenges with measurable business impact.
⭐ Attend industry conferences and study the latest research together with teammates.
⭐ Share your ideas in an open, supportive environment that celebrates learning and experimentation.
We’re here to build intelligent systems that understand, reason, and help people — and we’d love for you to be part of that journey.

job_description:
《閃動格子》是台灣首家融合大量感應式 LED 地磚與體感遊戲的多人挑戰系統，為玩家提供賽博龐克風格的遊戲體驗。遊戲設計讓玩家置身於不同顏色的感應磚中，通過跳躍和奔跑，在格子間挑戰不同關卡。遊戲格子分為綠、藍、紅三個顏色；綠色格子為安全區，藍色格子為需要踩踏的得分區，而紅色格子為踩到會扣分的扣分區。遊戲不僅考驗反應速度，也是一種運動和視覺的享受。玩家可以享受到遊戲的刺激和娛樂，同時也可以體驗到挑戰自己體能極限的樂趣。
